verdict.rationale: Cursor publishes agent-oriented docs. A same-day probe confirmed that cursor.com/docs/llms.txt returns a sectioned index (Agent, CLI, SDK, APIs), that every page renders as raw markdown at URL + .md, and that cursor.com/llms.txt and llms-full.txt also respond. The Origin API ships its own llms.txt/llms-full.txt plus machine-readable OpenAPI specs. missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: GET https://cursor.com/docs/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 "# Cursor Documentation" — a sectioned index (Agent, cloud-agents, CLI incl. headless, SDK, API Documentation with Cloud Agents/Admin/Analytics/AI Code Tracking/Origin APIs) whose pages all render as raw markdown at URL + `.md`
The Origin API publishes its own llms.txt/llms-full.txt and an OpenAPI spec
the downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec for the Cloud Agents API v1
